quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I've been working on a project called TryAI on the App Store – a tool that lets you experiment with and combine outputs from various leading AI models all in one place.

What it does:

- Generate text outputs from models like Grok, Claude, and Llama

- Create images using models like Flux and Imagen

- Produce videos with Kling and Minimax

- Mix and match outputs to create hybrid AI-generated content

I built this because I was tired of jumping between different apps and platforms while prototyping AI-powered features. I wanted a single playground where I could test different models, compare their outputs, and experiment with combining them.

The app is designed to be straightforward enough for casual users but I'm aiming to build out more powerful use cases for developers looking to prototype or benchmark different models.

I'd love feedback from the HN community on:

- Which additional models would you want to see integrated?

- What features would be most useful for your workflow?

- Any specific benchmarking or comparison tools that would help in evaluating outputs?

- Performance issues you encounter on different devices

This is very much a v1, and I'm looking to iterate quickly based on community feedback.

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tryai/id6670329122

Thanks!
